transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. Here is my full colleague observations report. Over the past two months, I've worked alongside Rina on the customer-success team and observed her handling of difficult customer cases. As I disclosed for the record, I personally witnessed her successfully de-escalate three separate difficult customer cases. In each instance, Rina remained calm, listened actively to the customer's concerns, acknowledged the issue without becoming defensive, and worked toward a resolution that left the customer satisfied. In one case, a customer was upset about a delayed response to their ticket; Rina acknowledged the frustration, provided a clear timeline for resolution, and followed through promptly. In another, a customer was confused about a billing discrepancy; Rina walked them through the details patiently and coordinated with the billing team to correct the issue. In the third, a customer threatened to escalate to management; Rina de-escalated the situation by addressing their concerns directly and offering a concrete action plan. Beyond these three cases, my observations align with what's already in the review packet — Rina has been dependable in routine work, consistently meeting her regular account management responsibilities. I believe her demonstrated ability to handle customer escalations is a strong positive indicator for her post-probation evaluation, particularly given that the department considers escalation handling when evaluating customer-success employees. That concludes my colleague observations report. I confirm that my report is complete.
